description: MUTATING: create a new support ticket. `subject` and `comment_body` are required; the comment becomes the ticket's first message. Zendesk REST: POST /tickets.json.

assignee_id.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to.

comment_body.description: Body of the ticket's first comment (required).

comment_public.description: Whether the first comment is public (default true).

group_id.description: Group id to assign the ticket to.

requester_id.description: User id of the ticket requester.

status.description: Status: new | open | pending | hold | solved | closed.

tags.description: Tags to set on the ticket.

name: zendesk_create_ticket
title: Create ticket
